subject: Let the CLI read an issue together with its change scope in one call

body.need: A way to read an issue and the projects its change may affect in one request, instead of one request per affected project.
body.rationale: The CLI shows a pre-merge summary; today it makes one call per project and is slow on issues that touch many projects.
body.impactIfDeclined: The summary stays, but takes several seconds on wide changes.
